cues.text: Hello, Elite Travel, this is Emily speaking, how may I assist you today?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Hi, I have a group visit to plan, and I wonder whether you could help me decide on which hotel to book.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: I have narrowed it down to either the Winchester, the Royal Hotel, or the Star Hotel.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: I am wondering if you have a recommendation.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: I would be happy to help! Those three are excellent choices.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: If everyone is booking hotel rooms independently, an easy way to do it is online booking.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: The Star Hotel offers online booking at no additional charge.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: It sounds fine!
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yeah, and you can even book the gorgeous sea view rooms if you act quickly.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Hm, I will consider that.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: It would be great since we are mostly first-time visitors to the area to get a nice view of the water.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Now, are there handicap accessible rooms?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yes, all three options have access for the physically disabled.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Great. I should also mention that we will be on a tight schedule, so we won’t have much time to go out for meals.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Which of these hotels serve food?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: There is a limited continental breakfast menu at the Star and at the Winchester.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: For a full restaurant and room service, the Royal Hotel is your best bet.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Oh wonderful! Could you tell me more about the restaurant?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Absolutely. In the morning there is a gourmet buffet or a la carte item, and after 11 a.m. lunch is served in the dining room.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Dinners are in a nice, low-key but high quality setting in the hotel’s private dining room and Fridays feature the house jazz band.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: How lovely! Is there a group discount?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: No, sorry. Not at the Royal hotel. Let me check on the others, though.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Could I place you on hold for just a second?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Sure, thanks.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: It looks like there is one at the Winchester - 15% off when you book 8 or more rooms.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Really? Sold! We’ll book at the Winchester.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Wait - is it suitable for children though?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: We’ll have a few little ones in our group, and it would be great to have a way to keep them occupied.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yes. In fact, it has a play place that kids just love, with slides, and swings and everything.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Definitely a good hotel to bring the kids.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Okay, great.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: So now I know where we'll be staying, what next?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Should I go ahead and book transportation and assign rooms and everything?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Well, for now, there are only a few things for you to take care of.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: We will hold a block of rooms for you as soon as you send a deposit.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: I recommend booking as soon as possible, so you know how many rooms to hold.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Oh, right. Okay, I’ll send the invitations and put down the deposit.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Is there anything else I should take care of?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Great! And don’t worry about this now, but sometime before you arrive do let us know if you’ll be requiring our transport service to and from the airport.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: I’ll make sure to let you know. Does that incur a service charge?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Or perhaps a tip, or some presents to show our gratitude for the personal car service?
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Oh, don’t worry about it. It is a free service, so if you would like to tip you are welcome to do, but hotel drivers do not accept gifts
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Thanks for your help!
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: My pleasure. Enjoy your stay at the Winchester!
cues.speaker: Agent
